title: Taiwan to Ban Heated Tobacco Products on All Flights From 1 December
summaryZh: 12月1日起所有航班全面禁用加熱菸，違者最重可判五年。
summaryHi: 1 दिसंबर से ताइवान की सभी उड़ानों में हीटेड तंबाकू उत्पादों पर पूरी रोक।
summaryEs: Desde el 1 de diciembre, Taiwán prohíbe el tabaco calentado en todos los vuelos.
summaryJa: 12月1日から全航空便で加熱式たばこの使用を禁止、違反は最長5年の刑。
summaryKo: 12월 1일부터 대만 모든 항공편에서 궐련형 전자담배 사용 금지.
summaryEn: From 1 December, heated tobacco products will be banned on all flights in Taiwan.
paragraphs: Taiwan is tightening its rules on smoking in the air. The Civil Aviation Administration (CAA) announced on Tuesday that the use of heated tobacco products will be prohibited on all flights starting on 1 December.

Unlike traditional cigarettes, heated tobacco devices warm tobacco rather than burn it, and some users regard them as a less harmful alternative. However, under the new regulation, passengers will not be permitted to use them at any stage of a flight. The current ban on e-cigarettes remains in place.

According to the CAA, the move brings aviation rules into line with the Tobacco Hazards Prevention Act. The agency also pointed to the safety risks posed by newer tobacco and nicotine products, warning that they could create fire and smoke hazards on board and push up maintenance costs for airlines.

Offenders could face harsh penalties. Under the Civil Aviation Act, breaking the rule can lead to up to five years in prison, detention or a fine of up to NT$150,000 (about US$4,560). If a violation causes serious injury, the sentence rises to between three and ten years, and if it causes a death, offenders face at least seven years or life imprisonment.

The CAA has urged travellers to check the regulations on their airline's website or at the check-in counter before boarding, and to keep e-cigarettes, heated tobacco devices and related accessories switched off and unused throughout the flight.
Taiwan has a new rule for people on planes. From 1 December, people cannot use heated tobacco on any flight.
Heated tobacco is a kind of smoking product. It heats tobacco but does not burn it. Many people think it is safer, but it can still be a problem on a plane.
The Civil Aviation Administration told the news on Tuesday. It said these products can start a fire or make smoke. They can also make it cost more to fix and clean planes.
E-cigarettes are already not allowed on flights. That rule will stay the same.

People who break the rule can go to prison for up to five years. They can also pay a fine of up to 150,000 Taiwan dollars. Before you fly, check your airline's rules and keep these devices turned off.

paragraphs: Passengers on flights in Taiwan will soon face a new restriction. The Civil Aviation Administration (CAA) announced on Tuesday that heated tobacco products will be banned on all flights from 1 December.
Heated tobacco devices warm tobacco instead of burning it. Under the new rule, passengers will not be allowed to use them at any time during a flight. The existing ban on e-cigarettes will continue.

The CAA explained that the change follows Taiwan's Tobacco Hazards Prevention Act. It also said newer tobacco and nicotine products could cause fire and smoke on board, which is dangerous, and could increase the cost of maintaining aircraft.

The punishments are serious. Under the Civil Aviation Act, people who break the rule can face up to five years in prison or a fine of up to NT$150,000. If someone is badly hurt or killed, the punishment is much heavier.
The CAA advises travellers to check the rules on their airline's website or at check-in. All e-cigarettes, heated tobacco devices and accessories should stay switched off for the whole flight.

paragraphs: Taiwan's aviation regulator is closing a gap in its smoking rules. The Civil Aviation Administration (CAA) said on Tuesday that, from 1 December, heated tobacco products will be banned outright on every flight.

Heated tobacco devices, which warm processed tobacco instead of setting it alight, are often marketed as a cleaner option than conventional cigarettes. That distinction will count for nothing in the cabin: passengers will be barred from using them at any point in a journey, while the long-standing prohibition on e-cigarettes stays in force.

The CAA framed the measure as a matter of both legal consistency and safety. It said the change aligns flight rules with the Tobacco Hazards Prevention Act, and argued that newer tobacco and nicotine products carry a risk of fire and smoke on board, as well as adding to the expense of aircraft maintenance.

Breaches are treated severely under the Civil Aviation Act. Offenders face up to five years' imprisonment, detention or a fine of up to NT$150,000, roughly US$4,560. Where a violation results in serious injury, the term rises to three to ten years, and where it leads to a death, the penalty is at least seven years or life.

Ahead of the change, the agency is advising passengers to confirm the rules with their airline, either online or at check-in, and to ensure that any e-cigarettes, heated tobacco devices and accessories remain switched off for the duration of the flight.
sentZh: 台灣的航空主管機關正在填補吸菸規定上的漏洞。
民用航空局（民航局）星期二表示，從12月1日起，所有航班都將全面禁止加熱菸產品。
加熱菸裝置是加熱加工過的菸草而非點燃它，常被宣傳為比傳統香菸更乾淨的選擇。
但在機艙內這種差別毫無意義：旅客在旅程中任何時候都被禁止使用，而長期以來的電子菸禁令也繼續有效。
民航局把這項措施定位為法律一致性與安全兩方面的問題。
它表示這項改變讓飛航規定與《菸害防制法》一致，並主張較新的菸草和尼古丁產品有在機上引發火災和煙霧的風險，還會增加飛機維修的開支。
違規行為依《民用航空法》會受到嚴厲處理。
違規者可處最高五年有期徒刑、拘役或最高新台幣15萬元（約4,560美元）罰金。
如果違規導致重傷，刑期提高至三到十年；若導致死亡，刑罰至少七年或無期徒刑。
在規定生效前，該機關建議旅客透過網路或在報到時向航空公司確認規定，並確保任何電子菸、加熱菸裝置及配件在整個飛行期間保持關閉。

paragraphs: Taiwan is set to extend its in-flight smoking restrictions to a newer generation of products. The Civil Aviation Administration (CAA) confirmed on Tuesday that heated tobacco products will be prohibited on all flights with effect from 1 December.

Heated tobacco devices heat tobacco without combustion, a feature that manufacturers frequently cite to present them as less harmful than conventional cigarettes. Nevertheless, the regulation makes no such allowance: their use will be forbidden throughout every flight, and the existing ban on e-cigarettes will remain unchanged.

The CAA justified the policy on two grounds. Firstly, it brings aviation rules into conformity with the Tobacco Hazards Prevention Act. Secondly, the agency contends that emerging tobacco and nicotine products pose a genuine fire and smoke hazard in a pressurised cabin and could drive up maintenance costs.

The penalties are notably stringent. Under the Civil Aviation Act, violators are liable to up to five years' imprisonment, detention or a fine of up to NT$150,000 (approximately US$4,560). Should an offence result in serious injury, the sentence increases to between three and ten years, while one that causes a fatality carries a minimum of seven years or life imprisonment.

In the meantime, the CAA is encouraging passengers to verify the relevant regulations on their carrier's website or at check-in, and to ensure that all such devices and accessories remain deactivated for the entire journey.
sentZh: 台灣即將把機上吸菸限制擴大到新一代產品。
民用航空局（民航局）星期二證實，自12月1日起，所有航班都將禁止加熱菸產品。
加熱菸裝置在不燃燒的情況下加熱菸草，製造商經常以這項特點把它們包裝成比傳統香菸危害更小的產品。
然而，新規定不作任何通融：整個航程中都禁止使用，而現行的電子菸禁令也維持不變。
民航局以兩項理由說明這項政策的正當性。
第一，它讓航空規定符合《菸害防制法》。
第二，該機關主張新興的菸草和尼古丁產品在加壓機艙內確實構成火災和煙霧危害，並可能推高維修成本。
處罰相當嚴格。
根據《民用航空法》，違規者可處最高五年徒刑、拘役或最高新台幣15萬元（約4,560美元）罰金。
若違規導致重傷，刑期增加到三至十年；若造成死亡，則至少處七年徒刑或無期徒刑。
在此期間，民航局鼓勵旅客在航空公司網站或報到時確認相關規定，並確保所有這類裝置與配件在整段旅程中保持關閉。

harsh.ex: The judge gave the thief a harsh sentence.

has.en: owns or holds; also forms perfect tense

hazard.ex: Wet floors are a hazard in the kitchen.

note.meaning: 危害；可能造成傷害的事物。
note.usage: 常見 fire/health hazard；pose a hazard。

example.en: Loose cables are a fire hazard in old buildings.
example.zh: 鬆脫的電線在老建築中是火災隱患。

noteHi.exampleTr: पुरानी इमारतों में ढीले तार आग का खतरा हैं।

noteEs.meaning: peligro; algo que puede causar daño.

noteJa.meaning: 害を及ぼすおそれのあるもの；危険。

noteJa.exampleTr: 古い建物の緩んだ配線は火災の危険がある。

noteKo.meaning: 해를 끼칠 수 있는 것; 위험.

noteEn.meaning: something that can cause harm or danger.

heat.ex: The heat from the oven filled the kitchen.

heavier.en: greater in weight or more serious

however.ex: It was sunny; however, it was cold.

hurt.ex: Nobody was hurt in the accident.

imprisonment.en: the punishment of being put in prison
imprisonment.ex: He faces ten years of imprisonment.

in-flight.ex: The in-flight meal was rice and chicken.

increase.ex: There was a 10% increase in sales.

injury.ex: The driver escaped without serious injury.

journey.en: travelling from one place to another
journey.ex: The train journey took four hours.

justified.en: gave reasons to show something was right

killed.ex: Two people were killed in the accident.

kind.ex: What kind of music do you like?

lead.ex: They have a small lead in the polls.

leads.ex: She leads a team of twenty people.

least.ex: You need at least two forms of ID.

legal.ex: She asked a lawyer for legal advice.

less.ex: This model costs less than the old one.

liable.ex: The owner is liable for any damage.

example.zh: 該公司被判須對損害負責。

note.meaning: 須負法律責任的；有義務支付的。
note.usage: liable for + 金額/損害；be held liable；liable to + 動詞（易於…）。

noteHi.exampleTr: कंपनी को नुकसान के लिए ज़िम्मेदार ठहराया गया।

noteEs.exampleTr: La empresa fue declarada responsable de los daños.

noteJa.exampleTr: その会社は損害の責任を問われた。
noteJa.meaning: 法的責任がある；支払い義務がある。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 회사는 손해에 대한 책임을 지게 되었다.

noteEn.meaning: legally responsible for paying or for something.

life.en: life imprisonment; prison for the rest of one's life

line.en: a long thin mark (fault line: point of division)

maintaining.en: continuing to say something is true

maintenance.en: work to keep something in good condition
maintenance.ex: The lift is closed for maintenance.

make.en: to produce; make use of: use

make.ja: 作る；（make use of）利用する

makes.ex: The company makes software for schools.

manufacturers.en: companies that make goods in large numbers

many.ex: Many people work from home now.

matter.ex: We will discuss the matter tomorrow.

meantime.ex: Dinner is almost ready; in the meantime, set the table.

measure.en: to show or judge the size of

not.ex: I do not like cold tea.

off.en: away from (off the coast); not allowed (off limits)

example.en: Driving without a licence is a serious offence.
example.zh: 無照駕駛是嚴重的違法行為。

noteHi.usage: commit an offence आम प्रयोग है।
noteHi.exampleTr: बिना लाइसेंस गाड़ी चलाना गंभीर अपराध है।

noteEs.exampleTr: Conducir sin carné es una infracción grave.

noteJa.usage: commit an offence の形が多い。
noteJa.exampleTr: 無免許運転は重大な違反だ。

on.ex: Voting will go on for nine days.

pay.ex: The nurses asked for better pay.

point.ex: Prices are at their lowest point.

present.ex: At present, the shop is closed.

pressurised.en: kept at a controlled air pressure

prevention.en: stopping illness or problems before they happen

problem.ex: There was a problem with the bus.

processed.en: changed by a series of steps

product.ex: This product is made in Japan.

prohibited.ex: Smoking is prohibited in the building.

note.usage: prohibit sb from doing sth；比 ban 更正式。

example.zh: 規定禁止企業互通價格。

noteHi.usage: prohibit sb from doing sth; ban से अधिक औपचारिक।
noteHi.exampleTr: नियम कंपनियों को दाम साझा करने से रोकते हैं।

noteEs.usage: prohibit sb from doing sth; más formal que ban.
noteEs.exampleTr: Las normas prohíben a las empresas compartir precios.

noteJa.usage: prohibit 人 from doing の形。ban より硬い。
noteJa.exampleTr: 規則は企業が価格を共有することを禁じている。

noteKo.usage: prohibit 사람 from doing 형태; ban보다 격식 있다.
noteKo.exampleTr: 규정은 기업이 가격을 공유하는 것을 금지한다.

noteEn.usage: Use 'prohibit someone from doing something'; more formal than 'ban'.

prohibition.en: an official rule that stops something

punishment.en: something done to a person who breaks a rule

punishments.en: things done to people who break rules
punishments.ex: The punishments for drunk driving are getting heavier.

push.en: a strong effort to get something

rather.ex: It wasn't cheap. Rather, it was quite expensive.

regard.en: think about in a particular way

regulations.ex: New regulations will limit noise near schools.

regulator.en: an official body that controls an industry
regulator.ex: The energy regulator set new prices.

relevant.ex: Please bring all relevant documents to the meeting.

remain.ex: The roads remain closed after the flood.

restriction.en: a rule that limits what people can do

restrictions.en: rules that limit what people can do

result.ex: Heavy rain can result in floods.

results.ex: The test results came out today.

rises.ex: The fine rises if you pay late.

risk.en: the chance that something bad will happen

rule.ex: There is an important rule to remember.

safer.ex: Wide pavements make the street safer for children.

safety.ex: Wear a helmet for your safety.

setting.ex: Check the weather before setting out.

smoke.en: grey or black gas from something burning

some.ex: Some fifty people came to the meeting.

someone.ex: Find someone to mind the children.

stage.en: a point in a process or time

stay.ex: Most tourists stay in the centre.

stays.ex: The hotel stays open all year.

still.ex: She is still waiting for the bus.

noteEs.exampleTr: Las normas de seguridad alimentaria son rigurosas.
noteEs.usage: Más formal que strict; stringent rules.

noteJa.exampleTr: 食品安全規則は厳格だ。

switched.ex: All phones must be switched off in class.

taiwan.en: an island country in East Asia

term.en: a fixed period, e.g. of a prison sentence
term.ex: He served a five-year term in prison.

these.en: the ones here or just mentioned

think.ex: Experts think a deal is possible.

tightening.ex: The bank is tightening its lending rules.

time.ex: For the first time, dentists will join.

tobacco.ex: Tobacco taxes went up again this year.

told.ex: My friend told me about the new café.

treated.ex: She was treated in hospital for a week.

tuesday.ex: The meeting is on Tuesday morning.

turned.ex: The firm turned in a strong profit.

unchanged.ex: The price has stayed unchanged for years.

under.en: under the arrangement: by the deal; under way: happening

up.en: up for grabs: available to get

urged.en: strongly asked someone to do something

use.ex: The use of phones in class is banned.

users.ex: All road users should slow down.

using.ex: Using a map helped us find the hotel.

verify.en: to check that something is true

example.zh: 旅客出發前應確認航班。

noteHi.exampleTr: यात्रियों को निकलने से पहले उड़ान की पुष्टि करनी चाहिए।

noteEs.exampleTr: Los viajeros deben verificar sus vuelos antes de salir.

noteJa.exampleTr: 旅行者は出発前に便を確認すべきだ。

noteKo.exampleTr: 여행객은 출발 전 항공편을 확인해야 한다.

noteEn.meaning: to check that something is true.

warning.en: a notice that danger may come

website.en: a set of pages on the internet

well.en: in a good or satisfactory way

where.ex: Nobody knows where the ball landed.

will.en: used to talk about the future
